newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tosoh, M'bishi Corp to make PVC in the Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Tosoh, M'bishi Corp to make PVC in the Philippines.

text.p: Major Japanese chemical producer Tosoh Corp said on Wednesday that it and Mitsubishi Corp would invest about six billion yen to build a vinyl chloride resin (PVC) factory in the Philippines.

The production facilities will be managed by Philippine Resins Industries Inc, which is 40 percent owned by Tosoh and Mitsubishi. Local companies, including Mabuhai Vinyl Corp, own the rest, the statement said.

Construction of the facilities will start before the end of this year and is expected to be completed in October 1998. The facilities will initially have a production capacity of 70,000 tonnes per year, the statement said.
Capacity is expected to double within a few years, it said.
Vinyl chloride resin is used in water pipes, agricultural plastic sheets as well as construction materials.
